activity.notes: Gung Ye founded the state conventionally called Later Goguryeo in 901, renamed it Majin in 904 and Taebong in 911, and remained its sovereign until he was overthrown in 918. ATLAS models this as one continuous Taebong polity reign rather than splitting the same political entity at its internal name changes.
